9. Only two persons live between the one who likes Orchid and the one who likes Sunflower, and the one who likes Orchid lives above the one who likes Sunflower.
10. At least one person lives between Rahul and Chitra.
11. Neither Fatima nor the one who likes Lotus lives on the topmost floor.
12. Bhavna likes Tulip.

Eight persons — Esha, Imran, Jatin, Lalit, Rohit, Sneha, Yash and Zubin — live on eight different floors of a building, one person on each floor, but not necessarily in the same order. The lowermost floor is numbered 1 and the topmost floor is numbered 8. Each of them is from a different city — Lucknow, Patna, Surat, Delhi, Mumbai, Agra, Bhopal and Indore.

1. Only one person lives between Esha and Jatin, and Esha lives above Jatin.
2. Only one person lives between the one who is from Bhopal and the one who is from Delhi, and the one who is from Delhi lives below the one who is from Bhopal.
3. More than four persons live between the one who is from Agra and the one who is from Indore.
4. Lalit does not live on an odd-numbered floor.
5. Only three persons live between Imran and the one who is from Mumbai.
6. As many persons live below Sneha as above Zubin.
7. Only one person lives between Zubin and the one who is from Surat.
8. Only two persons live between Sneha and the one who is from Surat, and the one who is from Surat lives below Sneha.
9. Esha is not from Mumbai.
10. Lalit is from Lucknow.
11. As many persons live below Rohit as above the one who is from Delhi.
12. The one who is from Bhopal does not live immediately above or immediately below the one who is from Lucknow.
13. The one who is from Indore lives on one of the floors above floor 5.
